🎋

Elegant & Lightweight Design

Bamboo-inspired design, simple and practical. No redundant dependencies, ready for medium/large projects.

⚙️

Vue3 + TypeScript Powered

Based on Vue3 Composition API, full TS support ensures safe, efficient development and scalability.

🧩

Rich & Customizable Components

Covers basic to complex components. Supports on-demand import, theme customization and style overriding.

🔧

Unified Build & Engineering

Vite-based packaging, auto type generation, ESM/CJS support, compatible with multiple build tools.

📦

Comprehensive Docs & Examples

Detailed docs, demos and source notes. VitePress-based site for quick onboarding.

🌿

Open & Evolving

Community-driven open source. Welcomes contributions to build a sustainable front-end system.
